note: Set B is better because it correctly binds most dimensions to their specific elevations (e.g., East Bedroom width, West Living height), whereas Set A frequently misattributes dimensions to the wrong elevation (e.g., assigning a South Bedroom dimension to North Living, West Bedroom width to North Bedroom). Set B also extracts more specific component dimensions (W2 width, TV offset) accurately, while Set A makes vague or incorrect attribute assignments (calling a width a 'room height'). Both sets incorrectly attribute the full wall width to window W1.
